resources.string: Measure how one app launches before and after DEX compilation. Results come from your phone, not an estimated booster score.
Before → Compile selected app → Cool down → After. Use matching charging, power-saving and network conditions.
Stopping prevents further launches. The active Android command must return before cleanup completes.

This is an observed before/after comparison, not proof that compilation alone caused a change. Cache warming, profiles, background work and network content can affect launch time. Five samples are a small diagnostic capture.

dex2oat compiles Android DEX bytecode ahead of time into ART-managed artifacts. A successful compile does not guarantee a faster app.

Launch median: the middle of five Android TotalTime readings, in milliseconds. Lower is shorter. Range: the fastest and slowest samples; all samples are retained.

Process-cold: Android closes the app process before launch. Filesystem caches and ART profiles are not erased. The first displayed frame may be a splash screen.

Compilation duration: time spent running the compile command. ART storage: reported compiled-artifact bytes, separate from overall free space.

Battery temperature and Android thermal status describe test conditions. This test does not measure battery savings, RAM reduction, FPS or CPU speed.
